diagnostics.summary: call to `String.join` has no argument named `values`.
diagnostics.label: unknown argument
causes: `String.join` does not declare a parameter named `values`.

fixes.title: Did you mean `parts`? Declared: parts, separator.

diagnostics.summary: match pattern `Some` cannot match scrutinee type `String`.
diagnostics.label: match pattern type mismatch
causes: RSScript match patterns must belong to the scrutinee's type.

diagnostics.summary: match pattern `None` cannot match scrutinee type `String`.
diagnostics.label: match pattern type mismatch
causes: RSScript match patterns must belong to the scrutinee's type.

diagnostics.summary: match arm has type `String`, expected `Unit` from the first produced arm.
diagnostics.label: match arm type mismatch
causes: A match expression must produce one compatible value type across every arm.

fixes.title: Return the same value type from every match expression arm.

diagnostics.summary: arithmetic operators are only built in for numeric values.
diagnostics.label: operator on non-numeric value
causes: RSScript does not support user-defined operator overloads.

fixes.title: Use a named function such as `Type.add(left: read a, right: read b)`.
